```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# load sig SNPs from corr analysis
cor<- read.csv("/Users/alexmacadam/Documents/GitHub/AGF-DArT/data/cor_sig_SNP_names.csv", header = T)
cor<- as.vector(cor$x)
# load sig SNPs from fisher test
fisher<- read.csv("/Users/alexmacadam/Documents/GitHub/AGF-DArT/data/fisher_sig_SNP_names.csv", header = T)
fisher<- as.vector(fisher$x)

in_both <- intersect(cor, fisher)
```

```{r}
#create a list object of significant genes 
sig_SNP_list<- list(Correlation=cor, 
                 Fisher_test=fisher
                 )

library(ggvenn)
af_venn<- ggvenn(
  sig_SNP_list,
  fill_color = c("#0073C2FF", "#CD534CFF")
  #stroke_size = 0.5, set_name_size = 4
  )
af_venn
```
